availability.uncertainty: Known public by download observation; earliest publisher availability remains unknown

collection.scope: Complete pinned 25-file credible_set Parquet release inventory; _SUCCESS is not a payload

matching: Exact studyLocusId equality in Arrow batches before Python conversion; retain every matching physical row and original file/row-group/row locator; no first-choice selection
duplicate_policy: Keep all matches; report multiplicity and per-field disagreements without resolving them
native_value_policy: Retain reported native finite values with source types, nulls and component names; represent native NaN/Infinity as explicit typed invalid-numeric context with null measurement and reason; no transformations, gene/drug direction, MR, prediction features or clinical claims

unknowns.units_reason: Not established by bounded native credible_set fields
unknowns.ancestry_reason: Not requested or inferred from another dataset
unknowns.upstream_study_reason: Native studyId may be retained but original upstream study identity/metadata were not verified

temporal_policy: New UTC cutoff after all download observations; contemporary evaluation-only descendant; no backfill into earlier runs or earlier cutoffs
receipt_policy: Exact inspected bytes copied into a private content-addressed archive; transport originals and state remain read-only
resource_policy: Record verification and scan time separately, logical bytes/rows/selected packet bytes; actual physical I/O unknown; Windows process peak RSS measured when available
